step: F1 freeze across a billing day moves that month by the freeze length
F1b after living through it: no month charged on a frozen day; one month after it
F2 freeze from today ended the same day: the month moves later, then back to its old day
F3 ended early after 10 of 30 days: the month is 10 days later than it was
F4 freeze starting on a billing day moves that month by the freeze length
F5 the billing day before the freeze is charged; the month after moves by 30
F6 billed on the 31st (30 Nov next), frozen 30 days: next month moves to 30 Dec
F6b the months after (as built: the new day of the month stays)
F7 cancel during a freeze: ends on the moved billing day (+36), series ends the day before
F7b cancelled during a freeze, then the freeze ended early (0 days frozen): when does it end?
F8 a freeze approved twice at once (and the job) moves the month once
F9 a future freeze ended before it starts: the month goes back to its day
F10 freeze fee at a no-card School is a waiting bank-transfer payment, in BRL
